description: Edit a work experience on your Himalayas profile by id (get_my_profile lists the ids). Only the fields you pass change. Uses the connected Himalayas account; no extra sign-in needed.

current_job.description: Whether this is the current job

experience_skill_list.description: Skills used in this role. Replaces the current list.

location.description: Country name for this role. Cities are not accepted.
